scenes.subject: The narrator on the bank at dusk, something walking far out on the lake

layers.foreground: his dark back at the bottom of frame, breath steam
layers.midground: the mud bank edge and flat black water
layers.background: a small figure far out in the last light, the lit boat beside the bank on the right

scenes.light_source: boat lantern and cabin window on the right, last orange at the horizon
scenes.motion: ripples lap the bank, the far figure inches closer
scenes.camera: slow push-in from behind his shoulder
details: lit cabin window on the right

scenes.subject: The post where he has stood for three nights; the answer is new

layers.foreground: the post with three notches in the lamp light
layers.midground: mud bank with his own footprints
layers.background: the dark lake, the walker closer

scenes.light_source: lamp on the post and moon
scenes.motion: lamp sways, reeds move, the walker grows
scenes.camera: slow turn back to the lake
scenes.sound_cue: old_calls_echo, his own thin voice from other nights

scenes.subject: The walker across the water with no ripples at its feet

layers.foreground: his silhouette in the foreground, still
layers.midground: the walker mid-lake, no rings around its feet while his own ripples spread
layers.background: the far ridge and a grey sky line

scenes.light_source: boat lantern behind him, moon front-lighting the walker
scenes.motion: the walker steps, leaning left, with flat dead-still water around its feet
scenes.camera: slow push-in on the walker over his shoulder

scenes.subject: His full name called out of the water

layers.foreground: the water surface just ahead of him
layers.midground: ripples forming where the voice lands
layers.background: the walker standing, head tilted, nearer

scenes.light_source: moon and the window light on black water
scenes.motion: tiny ripples spread from where the voice lands, lips of light across the surface
scenes.camera: still push-in with a slow handheld tremor

scenes.subject: Light falls across the water and shows the walker beneath it, inverted

layers.foreground: the surface of the water with a thin film of reflection
layers.midground: a pale figure under the surface, feet up at the surface, head down in the dark
layers.background: black depth below, the boat hull above

scenes.motion: the walker flips under the surface as the camera tilts down, pale limbs drifting
scenes.camera: tilt down from the horizon to the water, slow push
details: feet touching the surface from below

scenes.subject: The face under the water looking up at his boots

layers.foreground: mud and his own boots at the water edge
layers.midground: a pale oval under the surface, lips moving

scenes.light_source: boat lantern glowing down into the water
scenes.motion: lips shape words that do not match the sound
scenes.camera: tight push to the water edge, slight Dutch angle
scenes.sound_cue: water_knock, a voice coming from elsewhere

scenes.subject: Quiet: the face dissolves into the ripples, he holds his breath and wins
scenes.motion: the ripples fade, the water goes still, his shoulders loosen
scenes.withheld: what the lake will do next

scenes.subject: A wave with no wind rises and shoves him up the bank

layers.foreground: his soaked back as the water hits
layers.midground: the wave rising over the bank edge, little hand shapes in the foam

scenes.motion: a wave rises with no wind, hands-shapes in the foam shove him
scenes.camera: sudden handheld surge and a push-in
scenes.sound_cue: wave_no_wind, his own voice answering from the lake

scenes.subject: He lies on the bank, the lake quiet, the boat beside him

layers.foreground: his wet hair and hand in the mud
layers.midground: his body on the bank, boat resting beside him

scenes.motion: water dripping, lantern flicker, faint fog drifting
scenes.camera: slow pull-back from his hand to the lake
scenes.sound_cue: lapping water, then a soft echo of his own voice far out
scenes.withheld: whom the lake will call with his voice
